outline:
本課程可使學生瞭解：貨幣與資金市場、投資問題、如何取得資金與運用資金、使公司價值最大、使股東權益最大化、瞭解代理制度、瞭解公司股票、債務之利用，股利政策等事項。
This course has provided: money and capital market、Investments 、How to obtaining and using funds、Maximize the value o their firms、How to maximize stockholders' stock、To know agency problem 、To know the price of the firm's stock, use of debt and dividend policy.
schedule:
第1週 代理問題
第2週 市場效率性
第3-4週 財務報表分析
第5-6週 財務規劃與預測
第7-9週 第五章與第六章 財務決策、貨幣時間價值與折現定價
第10週 期中考
第11-12週 第七章 利率與債券定價
第13-14週 第八章 股票定價
第15-17週 第九章與第十章 淨現值與資本投資決策
第18週 期末考
The 1st week agency problem
The 2nd week market efficiency
The 3rd-4th week financial statements analysis
The 5th-6th week financial planning and forecasting
The 7th-9th week Ch5-Ch6 the financial decisions, time value of money and discounted cash flow valuation
The 10th week Mid-term exam
The 11th -12th week Ch 7interest rates and bond valuation
The 13th-14th week Ch8 stock valuation
The 15th-17th week Ch9-Ch10 net present value, and making capital investment decisions
The 18th week final exam
assessment:
課程參與度與小考 30%、期中測驗成績30%，期末測驗成績40%
Quizzes and participance 30%, mid-term exam 30% and final exam 50%
